name: Vila Pavão (Brazil)
description: Light blue field crossed by a white diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with the municipal emblem: a peacock over a yellow disc with the white map of the municipality between green, red and blue flags.
history: Vila Pavão is a municipality in the state of Espírito Santo, Brazil, settled largely by Pomeranians. Flags of the World records that the flag, designed by Ronaldo Furtado de Oliveira as winner of a public contest, uses the blue and white of Pomerania; the emblem shows the peacock of the town's name, the sun, the map of the municipality and flags in green, red and blue for the Italian, African and Pomeranian origins of its people.

features.role: municipal emblem with a peacock, a yellow sun disc and flags in green, red and blue
